key_concepts: Mixtures can be separated into their components by different techniques.
Sand and water form a heterogeneous mixture because sand does not dissolve.
Salt and water form a homogeneous solution because salt dissolves.
Oil and water form a mixture and oil floats on water because water is denser.
Decantation separates immiscible liquids or liquid from solid by pouring.
Filtration removes undissolved solid particles from a liquid using a filter medium.
Sieving separates coarse from fine particles based on particle size.
Evaporation separates soluble solids from liquids by heating until the liquid evaporates.
Winnowing uses wind to separate heavier from lighter components.
Scooping uses a scoop to separate easily recognized substances.
Using a magnet separates magnetic materials from non-magnetic materials.
